fields.label: Quantity
fields.description: The amount included with the plan — a VM plan's spec size, or a metered service's free allowance per cycle. Billing runs on this number directly; usage beyond it is charged at the Catalog Rate per Unit.

fields.description: Label for one unit of Quantity (e.g. 100 with Unit “1K tokens” means 100 × 1K tokens). Reference only — never used in a calculation; the Catalog Rate is quoted per this unit.
